tagline: AI Visual Tile Search  ·  Pricing Quote
hero_title: Find the right tile from a photo — in seconds.
hero_body: Drop a WhatsApp image, phone photo, or crop. TileVision AI searches your catalogue visually and ranks the closest matches.

features.title: Visual search
features.body: Match tiles from customer photos, WhatsApp images, crops & room shots — not file names.

features.title: Your catalogue
features.body: Indexes your own tile images (hundreds to thousands) into a private searchable AI index.

features.title: Best match first
features.body: Shows ranked results with similarity % so staff can confirm the right SKU quickly.

features.title: Crop tools
features.body: Auto Crop / Precise Crop / Manual Crop isolate the tile surface for better matches.

features.title: PDF catalogue
features.body: Export selected matches as a professional PDF to share with the customer.

features.title: Works offline
features.body: Desktop software for Windows & Mac — your catalogue stays on your computer.

included: Single PC activation (extra machines priced separately)
Software updates for the licensed term (Lifetime: current major version updates)
Catalogue indexing, visual search, crop tools & PDF export
Setup guidance for first-time install & first catalogue scan
why_points: Cut the time staff spend matching WhatsApp / phone photos against the physical catalogue.
Reduce wrong-tile dispatches — show ranked visual matches before the order is confirmed.
Built for Indian tile businesses (Gujarat & beyond) — works with your existing photo folders.

footer.validity: Valid for discussion · Prices in INR
